name: Report Generation
summary: Generation of reporting sections and summary tables for selected modules, including page-based preview navigation with retained setup state, Receiving-only summary rendering, dropdown-driven row-display selection, per-module table sorting, forced Loads/Skids combined-row counts in combine modes, and grouped-row validation that emits date ranges and explicit mixed-value placeholders.

uiElements: Collapsible row display mode settings card
userActions: Choose how grouped detail rows are shown
Choose how each module preview table is sorted
Return from preview to setup without losing selections
validationHints: Confirm Generate Reports opens the dedicated preview page and Back returns to setup with prior selections intact
Confirm only Receiving shows a summary table in preview and copied report output
Confirm each row-display mode produces the expected grouped detail rows for supported modules
Confirm each module preview table can sort independently by the selected sort field and direction
Confirm combine modes force the Loads/Skids detail column on and replace its value with the grouped row count
Confirm reports still generate correctly for the selected modules
Confirm grouped date-like values render meaningful ranges when combined rows differ
Confirm grouped non-date values render explicit placeholders such as Multiple Receivers instead of silent blanks
